title: REST API
statement: The system shall expose every capability over a JSON REST API under /api, serving the web UI at /.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: CRUD, 409 conflicts, bulk, trace, meta, paging, facets, lint pages, context, CSV export and the UI respond as specified
Code, scan, evidence, verification and impact routes respond as specified
